hypothesis: A decoder-rebuilt last-32 successor posterior conditioned on the immediately preceding same-stream symbol saves at least 10000 actual bytes over the faithful NNCP trace and at least 1000 bytes beyond the unconditional cache while remaining positive in every original-coordinate third.
interfaces_exposed: Faithful same-symbol branch probabilities plus decoded predecessor and last-32 same-stream pairs -> addressless successor posterior -> exact arithmetic stream
kill_condition: Any identity failure, gain below 10000 bytes, nonpositive third, either control margin below 1000 bytes, or source excess retires last-32 immediate-successor marginal without window, lag, prior, reset, or blend sweeps.
promotion_condition: Two independently terminated successor streams are byte-identical, decode every exact symbol, save at least 10000 actual bytes versus faithful, beat unconditional cache by at least 1000 bytes and lag-17 context by at least 1000 bytes, remain positive in all thirds, and compressed source is at most 65536 bytes.
retired_neighborhoods: Do not inherit score from NNCP or midpoint; do not vary cache geometry or mixture priors after this exact gate.
title: NNCP addressless successor-cache marginal
